prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 92.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 96.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 76.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 41.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post Certificate Account Security Flow Reorder: Moves the sign-in screen to occur immediately after adoption certificate confirmation, allowing users to experience pet creation before auth. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after sign-in, while 26.9% drop off occurs during adoption creation prior to commitment.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interactive Training Screen: Adds an interactive training screen right before completion where users practice hotkeys, hiding, and talking to their pet on screen. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets, and 23.9% drop off at the final completion step.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Companion Display Pre-Check Screen Flow: Inserts a pre-spawn diagnostic screen before waiting that verifies multi-monitor rendering and screen coordinates. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not rendering on desktop or failing to open, while the home step mean wait duration is 2336s.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Lighting Quality Guidelines Hint: Displays a clear visual hint on the photo upload screen recommending high lighting contrast and front-facing poses. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted visual results, contributing to adoption stage dropoff.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop System Tray Readiness Notification Alert: Enables an explicit opt-in system tray notification and audio alert when pet creation rendering finishes. (why: Users leave the application running in the background during long wait times (mean 2336s) and miss completion.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Data Protection Notice: Updates headline and body text to explain how account authentication protects custom pets from being reset or lost. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after re-signing in or restarting sessions.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Split Screen Path Selection Workspace Layout: Reconfigures the path choice screen into a side-by-side split screen comparing quick preset adoption versus custom AI generation. (why: Choose path screen has an 83.0% conversion rate with a large disparity between median 8s and mean 514s time taken.)
